connections.testsNote: Tests call each provider from this machine, the way SillyTavern does. They only ask for the model list and balance; nothing is sent to a model unless you ask.
connections.needsSillyTavern: Some connections can only be tested through SillyTavern. Start SillyTavern and test them again.
connections.modelsDescription: The models the last test found.
connections.modelsExpired: The list is kept for a day after a test. Test again to see it.
connections.modelsMore: {count} more. Type to narrow the list.
connections.sendBody: This sends one very short message, so the provider bills a few tokens. Use it to be sure the model really answers, not only that the key is accepted.

codeHints.ok: The provider answered and listed its models.
codeHints.invalid_key: The provider refused this key. It may be wrong, revoked or expired.
codeHints.no_credit: The key works but the account is out of credit or quota.
codeHints.rate_limited: The provider is limiting requests right now. Try again in a minute.
codeHints.unreachable: Nothing answered at that address. Check the address and the network.
codeHints.bad_url: Something answered, but it is not the API. Check the address.
codeHints.no_key: There is no key to test with. The profile names a deleted key, or the provider has none.
codeHints.needs_sillytavern: This one can only be tested through SillyTavern, and SillyTavern is not running.
codeHints.unsupported: There is no way to test this provider from here.
codeHints.unknown: The test failed and the provider did not say why.

connections.loadFailed: The connections could not be read. Try again in a moment.
connections.noProfile: There is no SillyTavern data yet. Install SillyTavern or restore a backup first.
connections.legacySecrets: These keys are still stored the way SillyTavern kept them before 1.13.1. SillyTavern will convert them the next time it starts; until then each provider has one key with no label.
connections.unreadable: {file} could not be read. Its section is empty until SillyTavern writes it again.
connections.keysEmptyHint: Keys you add in SillyTavern's API connections panel show up here.
connections.keyActiveHint: SillyTavern uses this key for its provider unless a connection profile names another.
connections.profilesEmpty: No connection profiles. Create them in SillyTavern's Connection Profiles panel.
connections.profileKeyMissingHint: This profile names a key that is no longer in SillyTavern, so it falls back to whichever key is in use.
connections.readNote: Read from SillyTavern's files, so this works while it is stopped. Changes made in an open SillyTavern tab appear here once SillyTavern saves them.

extensions.switchBrokenBody: These started failing after the update: {names}.
extensions.switchGoBackBody: The previous version is put back. Your chats and settings stay as they are now.
extensions.switchRestoreData: Also put my data back as it was before the update
extensions.switchRestoreDataWarning: Chats and changes made since {when} will be lost.
extensions.switchSaverNoCopy: Saver mode keeps no copy from before the update, so only the version goes back.
extensions.switchNoCopy: The copy from before the update is no longer there, so only the version goes back.
extensions.switchDisableDone: Turned off. Reload SillyTavern in your browser.
extensions.switchRolledBackTitle: SillyTavern {version} did not run with your data, so {previous} is back
extensions.switchRollbackFailedTitle: SillyTavern {version} did not run, and going back to {previous} failed
extensions.title: Third-party extensions
extensions.loadFailed: The extension list could not be read.
extensions.emptyDescription: Extensions you install in SillyTavern show up here.
extensions.shadowedHint: SillyTavern loads this profile’s extension of the same name instead.
extensions.noGitHint: This folder is not a git checkout, so it cannot be updated from here.
extensions.gitMissing: Git is not available on this machine, so update details are not shown.
extensions.scopeNote: Extensions for this profile are in its backups. Extensions for all profiles belong to the installed SillyTavern and are not backed up.
extensions.updateDone: Update finished. Reload SillyTavern in your browser to load it.
extensions.updatePartial: Some extensions could not be updated. The log says why.
extensions.rollBackDone: Rolled back. Reload SillyTavern in your browser to load it.
extensions.rollBackBody: It goes back to the version it had before the last update made here. Its settings stay as they are.
extensions.installDescription: Paste the address of the extension’s repository. Only https addresses are accepted.
extensions.installBranchHint: Leave empty for the default branch.
extensions.installDone: Installed. Reload SillyTavern in your browser to load it.
extensions.toggleBody: If SillyTavern is running, it restarts so the change is not overwritten. Reload its tab in your browser afterwards.
extensions.toggleDone: Done. Reload SillyTavern in your browser.
extensions.removeBody: It moves to the trash below and can be put back for {days} days. After that it is deleted.
extensions.reconnectBody: A fresh copy from {url} would replace the files there now. The current folder goes to the trash, so nothing is lost.
extensions.reconnectRemovedHint: Files only in your copy may be settings the extension saved there. They stay in the trash with the old folder.
extensions.reconnectDone: Reconnected. It can be updated from here now.
extensions.trashRestored: Put back. Reload SillyTavern in your browser to load it.
extensions.brokeAfterHint: Its first error came within a day of switching to SillyTavern {version}.
extensions.errorsDescription: What it reported in your browser, newest first. Only the error text is kept, on this machine.
extensions.pluginsNote: Server plugins run inside SillyTavern itself. One that fails to load can stop it from starting.

setup.title: Set up your manager
setup.telemetryNotice: The manager reports how much it is used, so the project can be improved. Your chats, characters, prompts and API keys are never sent.
setup.terms: I agree to the {terms} and the {disclaimer}, and I understand that my data and my use of this software are my own responsibility.
setup.connectionError: Cannot reach the manager. Try again.
setup.subtitle: Everything stays on this machine. Choose the password that opens it.
setup.loginSubtitle: This is the manager’s password, not SillyTavern’s.
setup.cloudSubtitle: The safest place for your data.
setup.cloudClaim: A lost computer no longer means lost data.
setup.cloudBody: Your chats, characters and settings are synced continuously to cloud storage of your own.
setup.cloudPointFree: Free on Cloudflare R2’s free plan.
setup.cloudPointRestore: Reinstalling SillyTavern on another machine? Sign in and your data comes back by itself.
setup.addressFound: The app’s own link was found
setup.addressHint: Open it for the best experience.
setup.addressOwnLink: Make a link of its own instead
setup.ownLinkBody: One fixed address through Cloudflare, guarded by the password you just set.
setup.ownLinkNext: Sign in there with the password you just set. SillyTavern is installed once you do — nothing starts here in the meantime.
setup.ownLinkFailed: The link could not be opened
setup.cloudSignInFailed: The Cloudflare sign-in could not be started
setup.cloudNotOwner: This manager belongs to a different Cloudflare account. Sign in with that one, or use the manager password.
setup.cloudAccountRequired: No account was chosen, so there is nobody to sign in. Try again and pick one.
setup.cloudUnavailable: This manager cannot sign in with Cloudflare.
setup.cloudDenied: Access was not granted on Cloudflare.
setup.cloudExpired: That sign-in link has expired. Start again.
setup.cloudReturning: Signed in. Returning to the manager...
setup.cloudReturningApp: Signed in. Taking you back to the ST Manager app...
setup.mismatch: The two passwords are not the same
setup.signedOut: You were signed out. Sign in again to carry on.
setup.passwordRejected: That password cannot be used. Use 6 to 256 characters.
setup.termsRequired: The terms have to be accepted to carry on.
setup.alreadyConfigured: This manager already has a password. Reload the page to sign in.
setup.setupNeeded: This manager has no password yet. Reload the page to set one.
setup.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.

console.usageConsoleHint: Counted only while the page is in front of you
console.uploadKeepTabOpen: You can use the other pages meanwhile. Do not close or reload this browser tab until the file is sent.
console.uploadFromApp: The app is sending the file. You can use the other pages meanwhile.
console.termuxOfferBody: Bring your chats, characters and settings over from it. Termux stays as it is.
console.bubbleOfferBody: When a character replies while you are in another app, their message floats over it as a bubble, the way a messenger shows one. Tap it to answer right there.
console.bubbleOfferDone: Chat bubbles are on. You can turn them off in the bell at the top.
console.termuxStepsBody: Copies your SillyTavern data from Termux to SillyTavern in STM.
console.termuxGuideAlt: In the picker: open the menu, choose Termux, tap Use this folder, then Allow.
console.termuxNotFound: No SillyTavern was found in that folder. Choose Termux, or the SillyTavern folder in it.
console.termuxTooOld: This SillyTavern is too old to move. Update it in Termux, then try again.
console.termuxMissing: Termux is not on this phone.
console.termuxRestored: Moved. What STM had before is in the backup "{name}"; restore it to go back.
console.dataBusy: Something is already running on the Data page. Wait for it to finish, then try again.
console.autoStartSillyTavernHint: Off if you would rather start it yourself.
console.nightlyUpdate: Update SillyTavern by itself at night
console.nightlyUpdateHint: Between 4 and 5 in the morning by this machine’s clock, when nothing has used SillyTavern for an hour. Your data is copied first, except in saver mode, and a version that will not run is taken back.
console.startupSaved: Saved. This takes effect the next time the manager starts.
console.saverHint: For machines with little room for files: no local backups, only backups to the cloud.
console.saverFromEnvironment: Set by STM_SAVER, so it can only be changed there.
console.saverInMemory: Turned on automatically because this machine keeps its files in memory: files and programs share {memory}.
console.saverLowDisk: Turned on automatically because the disk had only {disk} free when the manager started.
console.saverLocalOff: Saver mode is on, so no backups are kept on this machine. Cloudflare R2 holds your recovery points instead.
console.restoreStoppedPartwaySaver: The restore was stopped partway, so this profile holds a mix of old and new. Saver mode keeps no local copy: restore the newest recovery point from R2 to put it back.
console.keepOnlineHint: A battery saver, or the machine this runs on, can shut STM down when nothing has used it for a while. SillyTavern goes with it.
console.keepOnlineEveryHint: Shorter if this machine goes quiet sooner.
console.keepOnlineLocal: Nothing outside has opened this console yet, so it holds itself at {address}.
console.installStopConfirmBody: What has been downloaded so far is thrown away and the manager puts the machine back the way it was. You can install again at any time.
console.storageTemporaryTitle: This machine may not keep your data
console.storageTemporaryBody: Storage on {machine} may only be temporary: a restart can wipe it, and some hosts shut idle machines down. Chats, characters and backups would go with it, for good.
console.storageTemporaryBodyUnnamed: Storage on this machine may only be temporary: a restart can wipe it, and some hosts shut idle machines down. Chats, characters and backups would go with it, for good.
console.r2Pitch: Your data stays safe in the cloud. If this machine breaks, is lost, or you move to a new one, connect to the cloud again and everything comes back.
console.r2Enabled: Back up to the cloud automatically
console.r2ColdEvery: Send images and the rest every (hours)
console.r2KeepDaily: Days that keep one point each
console.r2KeepWeekly: Weeks that keep one point each
console.r2Fetched: Brought back into the backup library. Restore it from there.
console.r2FetchFailed: The recovery point could not be fetched
console.r2DisplacedTitle: Another manager signed in with this Cloudflare account
console.r2DisplacedBody: {name} signed in with this Cloudflare account at {when}, so this machine has stopped backing up to the cloud and signed out of Cloudflare. To back this machine up to the cloud again, sign in here; {name} will then stop and be told the same.
console.r2LegacyRemoveFailed: The older backups could not be removed
console.r2UsageNote: Counted by the manager as it works, not read back from Cloudflare. The R2 page of your Cloudflare dashboard is the final word.
console.r2UsageShared: Counted into the bucket itself since {since}, so the month's total follows your data to a new machine. The R2 page of your Cloudflare dashboard is the final word.
console.r2SettingsTitle: Your cloud account holds your earlier settings from {name}, saved {when}. You can restore them to SillyTavern Manager here.
console.r2SettingsBody: SillyTavern Manager restores settings such as the PIN, the password and the SillyTavern version. Chats are not included: restore those from a point in the recovery points below.
console.r2SettingsPasswordWarning: The password of this console changes with them, and you will be asked to sign in again.
console.r2SettingsRestoreFailed: The settings could not be restored
console.localScheduleLabel: Back up automatically to this machine’s storage
console.localScheduleOffHint: No backups are taken on their own. Take one by hand before a big change.
console.localScheduleFailed: Could not save the backup schedule
console.r2EnabledOffHint: Nothing is sent off this machine while this is off.
console.r2NeedsSetup: Connect a Cloudflare account, or enter R2/S3 keys.
console.r2TurnedOff: Stopped backing up to Cloudflare R2.
console.r2FromEnv: Fields set in .env are shown here and can only be changed in .env.
console.r2UploadEveryHint: How often chats and settings go up. Images and larger files go a few times a day.
console.r2History: How far back you can restore
console.r2HistoryHint: Recent backups are kept close together; older ones thin out to one a day, then one a week.
console.r2HistoryExplain: Keeps the newest {recent} points in full, then one a day for the next {daily} days, then one a week for {weekly} weeks after that.
console.r2CustomHint: This doesn't match a ready-made option. Adjust the exact numbers below to change it.
console.r2UploadFailed: Could not upload the backup to R2

console.passwordSaveFailed: Could not save the SillyTavern password
console.rawYamlHint: Comments and anything not listed above are kept as they are.
console.managerPasswordHint: The password that opens this manager.
console.managerTunnelNeedsPassword: This manager has no password yet, and a link to it is open to whoever finds the address. Set one here and the link opens straight after.
console.managerPasswordSaveFailed: Could not change the manager password
console.restoreStoppedPartway: The restore was stopped and the data could not be put back automatically, so this profile holds a mix of old and new. Restore the backup ending in "-prerestore" to put it back as it was.
console.restoreStopped: Restore stopped. Your data is as it was before.
console.copyFailed: This browser would not hand over the clipboard. Select the address and copy it.
console.scanToOpen: Scan to open on a phone
console.checklistAllDone: All set. Your data is looked after.
console.passwordChangeSignsOut: Every device that is already signed in will have to sign in again.
console.stopConfirmBody: Anyone using it right now will be disconnected.
console.installConfirmBody: SillyTavern restarts on the new version. Your characters, chats and settings are kept.
console.tunnelOffConfirmBody: The current address stops working. Turning it back on gives you a different one.
console.lanOffConfirm: Turn off access from other devices?
console.lanOffConfirmBody: Phones and tablets on this network will no longer reach SillyTavern.
console.versionInstalledHint: This is the version running now. Pick a different one to change it.
console.reinstallConfirmBody: SillyTavern stops and the same version is installed again from scratch. Your chats and data stay as they are.
console.uninstallConfirmBody: The program is deleted so it can be installed again. Your characters, chats, settings and backups are kept.
console.newProfileBody: A profile is a separate set of SillyTavern data - chats, characters, settings - with a backup library of its own. Default and its backups stay exactly as they are; switch back any time from the profile menu.
console.backupNameHint: Leave it empty to name it by the date and time.
console.backupNoteHint: A restore point lets you come back to this moment whenever you want. The manager never deletes one by itself.
console.backupUpToDate: Nothing has changed since the newest backup.
console.backupRowMenu: What to do with this backup
console.deleteBackupBody: The archive is deleted from this machine. Whatever is in the profile right now is not touched.
console.restoreChoose: What happens to what is there now
console.restoreMergeBody: Mix the current data with the data in {name}.
console.restoreTooLarge: Too large for this machine: even without anything SillyTavern can do without, this needs {needed} and there is room for {available}. Free some space, or restore on a machine with more memory.
console.restoreJunkNeeded: Not enough room for all of it: this needs {needed} and {available} is left. Leave out the junk to restore.
console.restoreJunkOptional: Thumbnails, caches, old SillyTavern backups and extensions' git history. Chats, characters and settings stay.
console.restoreLosses: Replacing deletes {files} files ({size}) that are in the profile now and not in this backup.
console.restoreLostExtensions: These extensions are among them and go away entirely:
console.restoreLossesKeep: To keep them, choose Merge instead.
console.restoreDiscardUpload: Delete the uploaded zip from STM when done ({size})
console.restoreDiscardUploadHint: The original file on your device stays.
console.restoreRoom: Adds {needed} of the {available} this machine has room for.
console.restoreSafetySaver: Saver mode keeps no copy on this machine: SillyTavern stops, the current data is saved to R2 first, and the files are written as they arrive. Keep this page open until it finishes.
console.restoreUnknownBody: Restoring it would replace this profile with what the ZIP holds, which is not a profile. Check that this is the file you meant.
console.restoreUnknownAnyway: I know what this file is. Restore it anyway.
console.r2SetupBody: The endpoint and key pair come from the R2 page of your Cloudflare dashboard, or from your S3 provider.
console.uploadProxyPage: The server in front of the manager returned an error page instead of an answer. Try again.
console.uploadFailed: The upload did not go through.

console.lanOffDone: Only this machine can reach it now.

console.restoreDefaultsDone: The configuration is back to its defaults.

console.versionChangeHint: Changing the version reinstalls SillyTavern and restarts it.

console.cfErrorStateMismatch: That sign-in expired or was started somewhere else. Connect again.
